title: Design, data, delight: how to get your message across at tech business exhibitions
summary: In this photo essay from BTS at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre, we showcase highlights from the exhibition halls along with insights for innovators.
llm_summary: The BTS photo essay from the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre captures the most striking moments from the tech business exhibition, highlighting how thoughtful design, clear data visuals, and engaging storytelling can make a booth stand out. It offers practical tips for innovators on using layout, interactive displays, and concise messaging to attract visitors and convey their ideas effectively.
